About Us

# Built by builders, for builders

Agave is the financial operations platform for construction — built by a team that's spent over a decade solving hard data problems together.

About us

## A massive industry. With a mission to transform it.

Construction accounts for 13% of global GDP, but it’s been one of the slowest to adopt modern software. We founded Agave with a clear mission: to fix the way data moves across the construction industry, so contractors can operate more efficiently.

## Our values

Ownership

We think and act long term. We embrace the schlep and never say “that’s not my job”. We are relentlessly resourceful.

Bias for action

We default to acting, especially when decisions are reversible. We value speed and calculated risks. Done is better than perfect.

Low ego

We acknowledge we might be wrong and seek feedback to test our ideas. We aim for the truth and do not compromise for social cohesion.

Customer focus

We work backward from customer problems to create value. We avoid doing what seems cool or interesting to us.

Pragmatic optimism

We’re optimistic about the future and our ability to shape it. We create definite plans and avoid relying on hope and wishful thinking to achieve them.

Sound mind, sound body

We prioritize physical, emotional, and intellectual fitness.

results.title: Senior Sales Leader at Agave
results.text:
# Head of Sales @ Agave

- Location: San Francisco
- Other locations: Remote
- Type: FullTime
- Workplace: OnSite
- Team: Sales
- Department: Sales
- Compensation: $380K – $430K • Offers Equity • Offers Commission • Offers Bonus • Sign-on bonus, company-based performance bonuss

### tl;dr

- Agave builds applied AI for construction, fresh off a $15M Series A from Accel and YC ($20M+ funding to date). Our AI agents run on proprietary rails into the systems contractors already use, and AI is the fastest-growing part of the business. You'll build and lead the sales org that takes Agave from $X-XXm to $XX-XXXm ARR over the next 3 years, reporting directly to our CEO/co-founder.

- Your success will be the team's output. You’ll recruit and ramp new sales reps, coach the team, own forecasts and pipeline, build less-mature sales motions, help close strategic deals, and develop sales leaders under you.

- We're looking for someone who has built and led a strong sales team at a fast-growing startup at/near our stage with an overlapping GTM motion to ours. Construction/blue-collar vertical sales experience is preferred, not required. In-person in SF strongly preferred, and willingness to travel here often if you’re remote is required. Learn more about us here (link).

### Why are we hiring this role?

- We've hit product-market fit on our core product: 600+ customers and $X-XXm ARR. The core motion works and converts predictably. Our AI products are the fastest-growing part of the business: a third of new deals now include one, and we signed 8 new channel partnerships in the last month alone. What we don't have is someone who can scale it past our current stage, as we expand our platform to many products with individually significant revenue streams.

- Our CEO/co-founder has been the acting head of sales since day one and is now the bottleneck on coaching, hiring, defining and training new sales motions, and many more critical tasks. This role takes that over and expands it going forward.

- You'll step into a motion that already works: refined collateral, meeting templates, a clean CRM, SEs who run demos and handle domain depth, and strong inbound and referral volume converting at a high rate.

- You'll grow the current system and help build what doesn't yet exist, like defining pricing and value props for new products on our expanding platform, hiring and retaining talent for new roles, building new motions from scratch.

- No CRO planned above this role; you own the function and report to the co-founder/CEO. As the team grows, you'll lead a growing sales org and manage sales managers by end of 2027.

### Why this is a can't-miss role

- **The market is enormous and under-built.** Construction is a $12T global industry running on software built 20-50 years ago, much of it on-prem with no APIs. We spent 3 years building the rails to read and write across those systems, and we use them to deploy AI agents for invoicing, expenses, compliance, billing, financial reporting, risk-tracking and more.

- **AI products customers already buy.** If you're at a SaaS company bolting AI onto a legacy product, or at an AI-native company still looking for product-market fit, this is the third path: AI agents built on rails no one else has, sold into hundreds of customers through a motion that already converts.

- **You'll scale the sales org of a generational company.** The next 3 years take Agave from $X-XXm to $XX-XXXm ARR, and the org that carries it is yours to design: the reps, the managers under you, the motions, the playbooks.

- **Early-stage upside without early-stage risk.** 600+ customers, hockey-stick growth, and a $15M Series A from Accel. You get the ownership and scope of a Series A with a downside most Series As don't have.

- **Backed by people who've done this in construction.** Accel, YC, and investors and operators from Procore, Autodesk, PlanGrid, and Plaid.

- **Direct line to the CEO, no CRO above you, and a mandate to build leaders beneath you.** This is the seat where you do the best work of your career, and the title and scope grow with it.

### Responsibilities

**From day one, the team's number is yours.**

- **Own the team's output, across new-logo and expansion revenue.** You'll carry the team's aggregate quota and be accountable for every rep hitting their individual one. Own pipeline health, forecast accuracy, and CRM hygiene. Know exactly where the number is coming from, and where it's headed and why.

- **Roll-up your sleeves and help close strategic deals alongside your team.** You’ll build fluency in the nuances of our motion during onboarding so you can help AEs close large, strategic deals that materially impact our top-line revenue.

- **Audit everything and improve the system.** You'll sit in on rep calls, review and improve our CRM, talk to tons of customers and partners, and come back with a written view of what's working, what's broken, and what you'd change and why.

**Grow the team and the machine.**

- **Recruit and ramp.** The highest-leverage thing you'll do. Source, interview, hire, and onboard our next AEs and other GTM roles. Own the ramp plan and the ramp timeline.

- **Coach and develop.** 1:1s, call reviews, and deal coaching that make each rep measurably better. Diagnose where deals stall and unblock them. Manage underperformance directly and early.

- **Turn what works into a playbook.** Call scripts, templates, CRM workflows, dashboards, enablement, territory and quota design proposals. Run a weekly Sales Review with the whole company.

- **Build new motions.** Grow our outbound motion and SDR team, and mature our expansion/cross-sell motion to drive growth.

- **Take AI products to market.** Pricing, packaging, and the sales motion for each new AI product, including larger expansions into our biggest accounts.

- **Partner with the founders.** ICP definition and GTM strategy for each product launch, pricing and packaging structure for existing and new products, and the GTM hiring plan. You'll work with Account Management, Partnerships, Delivery, Product, and Engineering on anything that touches our customers.

### Requirements

**Required**

- **Hands-on selling experience.** You've personally closed deals in the last few years, and you'll close deals here during your ramp to learn the motion.

- **Strong people management experience.** You've directly managed reps and hit a *team* number. You've hired, ramped, coached, and let people go, and you can walk us through a specific example of each.

- **Startup stage fit.** You've done this role (or similar) at a company at or near our size and grown it from there. Someone whose experience is running a team inside a large, established sales org may struggle here, because most of the job is building things that don't exist yet without the abundant resources of a larger company.

- **Motion fit.** You've sold five-figure deals with faster sales cycles and inbound-skewed lead flow. Our motion is high-throughput, not six-month enterprise cycles.

- **In-person / willing to travel**. Based in SF (preferred), or willing to travel to our SF HQ at least 1 week per month (minimum requirement).

**Strongly preferred**

- Experience selling in a construction/blue-collar vertical; we'll make exceptions for strong fit on other dimensions.

- A track record of staying and growing: multiple promotions at 1+ company, no pattern of short stints.

- Joined a company at an early stage (<$15m ARR) and helped take it to mid/growth/late stage.

- AI fluency: you use AI daily in your own selling and management workflow, and you'd raise the team's bar for using it

- Experience as a sales leader, or a top sales IC working under a great sales leader, at high-growth startup

**Nice to have**

- Several years closing B2B SaaS deals

- You bring strong reps with you (sign of the best candidates)

- Experience managing managers, or evidence you're ready to

- Built or scaled an outbound or SDR function

- Multi-product platform sales experience

- Experience co-selling with channel partners; you and your team will regularly co-sell with partner reps across the construction tech ecosystem

**What we're looking for**

- **Proactive builder.** Self-directed, fills gaps without being asked. We can trust you to disqualify a poor-fit customer instead of signing them, and to hold your team to the same bar.

- **Coaching ability.** You can watch a call, name the one change that would have moved the deal, and teach it in a way that sticks with motivated reps.

- **Clear, persuasive communication.** You write crisp emails and documents, and can generate sharp counterpoints to customer hesitations on the fly. You raise your team's communication abilities.

- **Reads people well.** You know when to listen and when to push, and when a rep needs pressure versus backing.

- **Product curiosity.** You want to understand how the product actually works, in more detail than is typical for a salesperson.

#### Benefits

- **Equity:** competitive equity, so you share in the upside you're helping create.

- **Healthcare:** we cover 90% of your healthcare costs with several plan options.

- **401k:** we match 100% of your contributions, up to 4% of annual salary.

- **Performance Bonuses:** we offer annual performance bonuses when we hit company growth goals.

- **Relocation:** sizable relocation bonus for folks currently located outside of the Bay Area, and a bonus for anyone (even within the Bay Area) who moves within a 15-minute walk of our office.

- **Breakfast & Dinner, delivered:** breakfast and dinner stipends through DoorDash. Plus a kitchen stocked with coffee, snacks, drinks, and more.

- **Gym:** on-site gym with Peloton, squat rack, Tempo, Yoga setup, and more.

- **Visa:** we sponsor Visas (H1B, TN, etc.) for candidates who are a good fit!

- **Commuter benefits:** employees can make pre-tax contributions toward commuting costs, and we'll cover the full cost of a Muni pass for those using public transit.

- **Office Visits**: if you are remote, we will provide company-sponsored trips to our HQ in SF at least every other month. We’ll coordinate trips for other remote employees to coincide during “remote visit” weeks to maximize your touchpoints with teammates.

Apply here

Sales

## tl;dr

- Agave is profitable, cash-flow positive, and fresh off a $15M Series A led by Accel ($20M+ total funding). You'll work directly with our CEO/co-founder to build and lead our sales team, taking Agave from $Xm to $XXm ARR+.
- You'll start hands-on. You'll initially carry a book alongside our AEs, because the fastest way to learn this motion is to do it. After, you help build and scale the machine: recruiting and ramping reps, coaching the team, owning forecast and pipeline, and standing up less-mature motions like outbound and cross-sells. From that point on, your number is the team's number.
- We're looking for 4+ years closing B2B SaaS deals, 2+ years managing quota-carrying AEs, and experience at a startup at or near our stage. Construction experience is a plus, not a requirement. In-person in SF strongly preferred. Learn more about us here (link).

## Why are we hiring this role?

- We've hit product-market fit on our core product: 5XX+ customers, $Xm ARR, profitable and cash-flow positive for 2+ years. The core motion works and converts. What we don't have is someone who can scale it past our current stage.
- Our CEO/co-founder has been the acting head of sales since day one and is now the bottleneck on coaching, hiring, defining and training new sales motions, and many more critical tasks. This role takes that over.

## Responsibilities

Your first quarter: learn the motion by running it; earn the team's credibility by out-working them.

- Carry a personal quota. You'll join our AE rotation and run your own discovery calls, demos (with our Solutions Engineers), proposals, and negotiations. You’ll learn to repeat our current system well before doing anything else.
- Audit everything. You’ll sit in on rep calls, review and improve our CRM, talk to tons of customers and partners, and come back with a written view of what's working, what's broken, and what you'd change and why.

After that: grow the team and the machine

- Recruit and ramp. The highest-leverage thing you'll do. Source, interview, hire, and onboard our next AEs and other GTM roles. Own the ramp plan and the ramp timeline.
- Coach and develop. 1:1s, call reviews, and deal coaching that make each rep measurably better. Diagnose where deals stall and unblock them. Manage underperformance directly and early.
- Own the team’s output. You'll carry the team's aggregate quota and be accountable for every rep hitting their individual one. Own pipeline health, forecast accuracy, and CRM hygiene. Know exactly where the number is coming from, and where it’s headed and why.
- Turn what works into a playbook. Call scripts, templates, CRM workflows, dashboards, enablement, territory and quota design proposals. Run a weekly Sales Review with the whole company.
- Partner with the founders. ICP definition and GTM strategy for each product launch, pricing and packaging structure for existing and new products, and the GTM hiring plan. You'll work with Account Management, Partnerships, Delivery, Product, and Engineering on anything that touches our customers.

## What this role is not

- Not a pure management seat. You'll carry a personal quota initially, since the best way to learn is doing. If you haven't personally sold in a while, this will be uncomfortable. You need to earn the team’s trust and respect early. After ramping, you’ll stop carrying an individual quota and lead the team.
- Not Partnerships or RevOps. We have people who own our partner motion and revenue operations. You own the direct sales team.
- Not a large org on day one. You'll work with 4 AEs, hire more by year-end, and grow the team and its scope from there. Scope grows with results.

Hard requirements

- 4+ years closing. You've carried a quota at a B2B SaaS company and consistently exceeded it. You know what it takes to run a competitive deal and win it.
- 2+ years managing AEs. You've directly managed quota-carrying reps and hit a team number, not just your own. You've hired, ramped, coached, and let people go, and you can walk us through a specific example of each.
- Startup stage fit. You've done this role (or similar) at a company at or near our size and grown it from there. Someone whose experience is running a team inside a large, established sales org may struggle here, because most of the job is building things that don't exist yet without the abundant resources of a larger company.
- Motion fit. You've sold five-figure deals with fast sales cycles and inbound-skewed lead flow. Our motion is high-throughput, not six-month enterprise cycles.

Nice to have

- Selling software into construction, or another blue-collar or trades-heavy buyer base
- Familiarity with accounting or ERP concepts
- You bring 1-2 strong reps with you (sign of the best candidates)
- Has worked in a senior/leadership sales role (VP, Director, Head of Sales) for 1+ years
- Has directly contributed to $X-XXm ARR revenue growth to a scaling startup in <1-2 years

What we're looking for

- Proactive builder. Self-directed, fills gaps without being asked. We can trust you to disqualify a poor-fit customer instead of signing them, and to hold your team to the same bar.
- Coaching ability. You can watch a call, name the one change that would have moved the deal, and teach it in a way that sticks with motivated reps.
- Clear, persuasive communication. You write crisp emails and document, and can generate sharp counterpoints to customer hesitations on the fly. You raise your team's communication abilities.
- Reads people well. You know when to listen and when to push, and when a rep needs pressure versus backing.
- Product curiosity. You want to understand how the product actually works, in more detail than is typical for a salesperson.

Location
- In-person in SF strongly preferred. Our team has been fully in-person since day one, and this role is coaching-heavy, which works better in a room.
- We'll consider exceptional remote candidates in the US

## About Agave

We're building the financial ops platform for construction, a $12T global industry run by software built 20-40 years ago, much of it on-prem with no APIs and no documentation.

Our three co-founders have worked together for 12+ years, across Graphiq (acquired by Amazon in 2017) and Amazon.
